project.description:
The document model, as data: what a doc is (identity, title, summary, references) and what it is made of - markdown, the typed text grammar, composed segments, rigid trees, tables, images, and the SVGs and embedded widgets they point at. Pure values and functions: no ES modules, no server, no viewer, no wire format.
A doc never decides how it is shown. Content is made FROM a doc by a function (Function<Doc, Content>) - the legacy viewers' JSON is one, and it lives with them in homing-studio-base. The packages are the ones the model has always had, so every doc written against them compiles and runs unchanged.
Depends on nothing but the ontology markers and the rigid tree (itself substrate-free) - so the compiler, not a convention, keeps it pure.
